capabilities: Render markdown headings as a live mind map triggered by type: mindmap frontmatter
Edit nodes on canvas and write changes back to the markdown source
Switch layouts, color themes, line styles and node shapes per file
Insert wiki-links with vault-wide autocomplete and open them from nodes
Export the current mind map as a high-resolution PNG
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README is bilingual (English and Chinese) and context menus switch language with Obsidian's language setting.
problem: Obsidian shows headings only as a flat outline; there is no built-in way to visualize and edit a note's heading hierarchy as a mind map.
summary: Mindmap renderer that turns a note's markdown headings into an interactive, editable mind map with layouts, themes and PNG export.
